name: List.getElem?_zipWith_eq_some
typeText:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {f : α → β → γ} {l₁ : List.{u_1} α} {l₂ : List.{u_2} β} {z : γ}
  {i : Nat},
  Iff (Eq.{u_3 + 1} (GetElem?.getElem?.{u_3, 0, u_3} (List.zipWith.{u_1, u_2, u_3} f l₁ l₂) i) (Option.some.{u_3} z))
    (∃ x y,
      And (Eq.{u_1 + 1} (GetElem?.getElem?.{u_1, 0, u_1} l₁ i) (Option.some.{u_1} x))
        (And (Eq.{u_2 + 1} (GetElem?.getElem?.{u_2, 0, u_2} l₂ i) (Option.some.{u_2} y)) (Eq.{u_3 + 1} (f x y) z)))

source.code:
theorem getElem?_zipWith_eq_some {f : α → β → γ} {l₁ : List α} {l₂ : List β} {z : γ} {i : Nat} :
    (zipWith f l₁ l₂)[i]? = some z ↔
      ∃ x y, l₁[i]? = some x ∧ l₂[i]? = some y ∧ f x y = z := by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ i
  · simp
  · cases l₂ <;> cases i <;> simp_all
